name: The Sierra Club Foundation
story: Every **{climate: 1 / tco2e_per_donor_dollar|$}** keeps a tonne of carbon dioxide out of the air through campaigns against coal and gas and for clean energy and transport.
summary: The 501(c)(3) that funds the Sierra Club's charitable work: the Beyond Coal campaign, gas, clean-transport and clean-air advocacy, public lands and waters, chapters' public education and outdoor programmes. Nearly all its grants go to the Sierra Club (a 501(c)(4)).

spending.source: https://apps.irs.gov/pub/epostcard/990/xml/2025/2025_TEOS_XML_09A.zip (Form 990 for calendar 2024, IRS e-file object 202502689349300025, Part IX line 25: program services $87,490,405 of total expenses $102,142,815; Schedule I: $85,639,241 granted to the Sierra Club). The Foundation then moved its year end to June and filed a six-month return for January to June 2025 (programme services $44,619,601), a short year left out.
